# Community code of conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

Be respectful, technical, and evidence-driven. Discuss implementations rather than people; report reproducible failures with commands, logs, and environment details; never post credentials, private model-access tokens, personal voice samples without permission, or abusive content.

Maintainer decisions may prioritize security, licensing, reproducibility, and the documented Kaggle T4x2 scope. Serious conduct or security concerns should be sent privately to the maintainer rather than posted publicly.
